desks.name: Scheduler
desks.owns: Sam's time: the routine, calendars, school and kids' activities, appointments, trips and due dates

desks.name: Accountant
desks.owns: Balances, transactions, bills, net worth and the business expense split

desks.name: Health Agent
desks.owns: Training, targets, meal plans, recipes, grocery lists and carts, weigh-ins, appointments and claims

desks.name: Gift Concierge
desks.owns: Birthdays and occasions for family and close friends: gifts, budgets and cards; fills the cart, Sam checks out

desks.name: Relationship Manager
desks.owns: People lead: family and friends, contacts and households, staying in touch

desks.name: Home Manager
desks.owns: The home and the car: chores and supplies, repairs and who pays under the lease, upkeep and registration

desks.name: Financial Advisor
desks.owns: Credit (scores, reports, negative items) and investing and retirement (the paper bot, the 401(k), the emergency fund)

desks.name: Product Manager
desks.owns: Should as a product: name, logo, brand, roadmap and the public page

desks.name: Business Executive
desks.owns: Sam's companies: Carter Studio LLC and the planned Brightline Labs; filings, renewals and taxes

desks.name: Relationship Coach
desks.owns: Sam and Nora's relationship (a placeholder until Sam turns it on)

desks.name: IT Guy
desks.owns: Internet, Wi-Fi, phones and lines, devices, service health and the technical security fixes

desks.name: Software Architect
desks.owns: Brightline Labs lead: the product API, the plan and ADRs, the software team

desks.name: Event Planner
desks.owns: Events Sam hosts: guests, RSVPs, invites, timeline, run sheet

desks.name: Local Guide
desks.owns: Places Sam has been, places the family might like, local events, weekend picks and the weather

desks.name: Text Concierge
desks.owns: The texting flow: the listener, intake, groups and menus, prompts and rules

desks.name: Philosopher
desks.owns: How Should thinks: the north star, the knowledge base, the reading list and feature proposals

desks.name: Security Officer
desks.owns: Security threats: suspicious logins, breaches, weak and reused passwords, two-step sign-in

desks.name: Compliance Officer
desks.owns: Checks agent actions against Sam's values, the law and each site's terms

desks.name: Database Administrator
desks.owns: Every database schema change, plus performance, health and backups

desks.name: Designer
desks.owns: The design system and the look of everything Should builds

desks.name: Media Concierge
desks.owns: Picks what the family watches: one strong pick, where to stream it, the queue and the watched log

desks.name: Relocation Expert
desks.owns: Moves end to end: the lease, the search, the move plan, movers, utilities and address changes

desks.name: Career Assistant
desks.owns: Job search and freelance work: leads, recruiter replies, the resume and the portfolio

desks.name: PR Person
desks.owns: Sam's public profile: bios, the portfolio site and drafted posts (nothing posts without Sam's yes)

desks.name: Shopping Expert
desks.owns: Wise purchases: research, the wish list, price watch and cart prep (never buys)

desks.name: Clothier
desks.owns: Sam's clothes: wardrobe, outfit of the day, packing lists and care

desks.name: Pet Expert
desks.owns: Biscuit the dog: the vet, food and supplies, and the plan for trips

desks.name: Life Coach
desks.owns: How Sam is doing on everything: weekly scorecard, gauges, goals and the Saturday sit-down

desks.name: Business Coach
desks.owns: Long-term coaching for Carter Studio and Brightline Labs

desks.name: Travel Agent
desks.owns: Trips, fares, stays and cars; search and read only, Sam books from a link

desks.name: Investigator
desks.owns: Who is this and can we trust it: unknown numbers, duplicates, family gaps, scams; data-broker removals

desks.name: Legal Advisor
desks.owns: Agreements and deadlines: the lease, the LLC, the family trust plan (not a lawyer)

desks.name: Music Producer
desks.owns: The family piano and music software: recordings and sheet music

desks.name: Webmaster
desks.owns: The portal: pages, views and fixes
